notes.title: Version 2.0.1
notes.content:
THIS IS A BIG UPDATE FOR THE GAME!

UPDATES INCLUDE:

Pause menu during gameplay -
Fixed bugs and issues with the score -
Full controller support -
Added a new map called Striped -
Added a new map called Blackout -
Added a customizable difficulty -
Added German as a interface language -
Added Spanish as a interface language -
Added Portuguese as a interface language -
Added Russian as a interface language -
Added Japanese as a interface language -
Added Chinese as a interface language -


 HAVE FUN!
